propositions: Direct gated-close phase timings must be emitted via COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload using only time.monotonic_ns() and integer arithmetic without adding I/O, subprocess, network calls, tracker writes, or model calls.

Ten named timing fields (pre_verifier_total_ms, structural_scan_ms, material_policy_ms, descendant_scope_ms, landing_check_ms, verifier_call_ms, git_history_read_ms, alias_index_build_ms, ticket_ref_resolution_ms, diff_validation_ms) must be threaded through the existing close-ticket call graph as optional arguments.
Instrumentation adds no observable performance cost above 50 microseconds per close as measured by CPU-time ABBA microbenchmark with GC disabled and synthetic 2714-commit history.
Duration probe must consume direct timing fields when present and label legacy records lacking direct fields as legacy_uninstrumented without inferring a residual causal operation.
Existing completion consumption metrics must remain present and unchanged; sidecar workload counts must report commits inspected, distinct references, descendant ids, and referencing commits found.
